$comment: Permissions for agents working in this workspace.
These are the same rules the skills state in prose. They are duplicated here
because a rule that lives only in a prompt is a suggestion: it survives only
as long as the model keeps it in context. The two that matter — no direct API
calls, no editing .sync/ — are exactly the ones whose violation is silent and
expensive, so they are enforced rather than requested.
Adjust the allow list to taste. Do not weaken the deny list without

deny: $comment: the merge bases and cursors. A hand-edited base makes the next merge compute a difference that never happened.
$comment: issues/ mirrors a read-only external source; edits there are overwritten on the next pull.
$comment: going around the CLI discards schema validation, dry-run, duplicate protection and local-only stripping, all at once and silently.
